# AR Membership Manager

> Automated membership dues collection and ledger system with scheduled 9:00 AM WhatsApp reminders and 1-tap UPI payment links for gyms, yoga studios, tuition centres, and academies in India.

AR Membership Manager replaces manual spreadsheet tracking and awkward follow-up phone calls. It connects directly to the official Meta WhatsApp Cloud API and Cashfree payment gateway, running on your own Cloudflare infrastructure with zero recurring monthly platform fees.

## Core Capabilities
- **Automated WhatsApp Cadence**: Dispatches branded renewal alerts at 9:00 AM (-3 Days, Due Day, +3 Days Overdue).
- **1-Tap UPI Payment Links**: Direct Cashfree checkout links with dynamic member details; settlements land directly in your bank account with 0% platform cuts.
- **Auto-Renewing Ledger**: When a member pays, their next renewal date updates automatically.
- **Fair Late Renewals**: Overdue members renew from the actual payment date rather than lost past days.
- **Full Data Ownership**: Code and database deploy directly into your own Cloudflare account.

## Target Audience
- Gyms & Fitness Centres
- Sports Academies & Badminton / Tennis Clubs
- Dance, Music & Yoga Studios
- Tuition & Coaching Centres
- Co-working Spaces & Monthly Subscription Businesses

## Pricing (2026)
- **Lifetime Subscription**: ₹14,999 one-time (originally ₹20,000) + ₹500 setup fee. Zero monthly platform fees. Unlimited members. Deployed to client's Cloudflare.
- **Cloud SaaS**: Monthly subscription (Waitlist open). ₹0 setup fee (free configuration). Meta API & Cashfree configured in client's own accounts with zero platform fee cuts. Payments settle directly into client's bank account.
